aliases.description: Replaces the brand's other names. Names are trimmed, and repeated names are dropped.

items.description: One other name for the brand.

kind.description:
What the brand is to the project: 'own', 'competitor', 'publisher' or 'unknown'.

* `own` - Own
* `competitor` - Competitor
* `publisher` - Publisher
* `unknown` - Unknown

name.description: Brand name as people say it.

status.description:
'confirmed' to accept the brand, 'ignored' to hide it, 'suggested' to put it back for review.

* `suggested` - Suggested
* `confirmed` - Confirmed
* `ignored` - Ignored
